briefdescription.para: Validates header stamps, section alignment and bounds, version string, and all per-record indices and string-pool slices.

detaileddescription.para: Ensures no section overflows size, every non-empty section offset satisfies alignof(Record), and every FileEntry, SymbolRecord, HoverEntry, CompletionRecord, InlayHintEntry, DiagnosticEntry, and FixItEntry index or string slice is in bounds.

simplesect.para: True when the entire binary layout passes validation.

briefdescription.para: Memory-mapped or owned binary index of symbols, completions, hovers, hints, diagnostics, outlines, and fix-its for one translation unit.

detaileddescription.para: Builder collects records on a pool thread and writes one aligned, little-endian buffer with a fixed Header, typed section tables, and a trailing string pool. SymbolDocument validates the buffer once in isValidBuffer() and exposes typed Span views directly over the validated bytes.
